events.description: Called with the new value each time the user changes it.
events.name: onChange

events.description:
Handler that is called when the input value is about to be modified. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/beforeinput_event).
events.name: onBeforeInput

events.description: Handler that is called when the element loses focus.
events.name: onBlur

events.description:
Handler that is called when a text composition system completes or cancels the current text
composition session. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/compositionend_event).
events.name: onCompositionEnd

events.description:
Handler that is called when a text composition system starts a new text composition session.
See [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/compositionstart_event).
events.name: onCompositionStart

events.description:
Handler that is called when a new character is received in the current text composition
session. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/compositionupdate_event).
events.name: onCompositionUpdate

events.description:
Handler that is called when the user copies text. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/oncopy).
events.name: onCopy

events.description:
Handler that is called when the user cuts text. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/oncut).
events.name: onCut

events.description: Handler that is called when the element receives focus.
events.name: onFocus

events.description: Handler that is called when the element's focus status changes.
events.name: onFocusChange

events.description:
Handler that is called when the input value is modified. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/input_event).
events.name: onInput

events.description: Handler that is called when a key is pressed.
events.name: onKeyDown

events.description: Handler that is called when a key is released.
events.name: onKeyUp

events.description:
Handler that is called when the user pastes text. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/onpaste).
events.name: onPaste

events.description:
Handler that is called when text in the input is selected. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/select_event).
events.name: onSelect

props.description: Content before the value, on the inline-start side: short text, or an element such as an icon.
props.name: prefix

props.description: Content after the value, on the inline-end side: short text, or an element such as a button.
props.name: suffix

props.description: Hint text drawn inside the empty input. It never replaces the label: it is gone once the user types.
props.name: placeholder

props.description: The look of the field: `primary` on the page, `secondary` on a tinted surface. Defaults to `primary`.
props.name: variant

props.description: The kind of text, which sets the keyboard and the masking. Defaults to `text`.
props.name: type

props.description: True to fill the parent's width, false to size to the content. Defaults to true.
props.name: isFullWidth

props.description: The visible label; it is the field's accessible name, so a field without one needs the runtime's own name prop.
props.name: label

props.description: Help text under the field, tied to it for assistive technology.
props.name: description

props.description: What is wrong, shown under the field while `isInvalid` is true, and read out with the field.
props.name: errorMessage

props.description: True when the form cannot be submitted without a value; the label shows it and assistive technology is told.
props.name: isRequired

props.description: True to show the error state; the field alone never decides, so a form adapter sets it from its validation.
props.name: isInvalid

props.description: True to refuse input and show the disabled style; the field leaves the tab order and is left out of the submit.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: True to show the value but refuse changes; unlike disabled, the field keeps focus and is submitted.
props.name: isReadOnly

props.description: The current value, for a controlled field; pair it with `onChange`.
props.name: value

props.description: The starting value, for an uncontrolled field.
props.name: defaultValue

props.description: The name the value is submitted under in a form, and the key a form adapter binds.
props.name: name

props.description:
Identifies the currently active element when DOM focus is on a composite widget, textbox,
group, or application.
props.name: aria-activedescendant

props.description:
Indicates whether inputting text could trigger display of one or more predictions of the user's
intended value for an input and specifies how predictions would be presented if they are made.
props.name: aria-autocomplete

props.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.
props.name: aria-controls

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.
props.name: aria-describedby

props.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.
props.name: aria-details

props.description: Identifies the element that provides an error message for the object.
props.name: aria-errormessage

props.description:
Indicates the availability and type of interactive popup element, such as menu or dialog, that
can be triggered by an element.
props.name: aria-haspopup

props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.
props.name: aria-labelledby

props.description:
Describes the type of autocomplete functionality the input should provide if any. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#htmlattrdefautocomplete).
props.name: autoComplete

props.description:
An attribute that takes as its value a space-separated string that describes what, if any, type
of autocomplete functionality the input should provide. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#autocomplete).
props.name: autoCorrect

props.description: Whether the element should receive focus on render.
props.name: autoFocus

props.description:
The CSS [className](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/className) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the class based on component state.
props.name: className

props.description:
An enumerated attribute that defines what action label or icon to preset for the enter key on
virtual keyboards. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/enterkeyhint).
props.name: enterKeyHint

props.description:
Whether to exclude the element from the sequential tab order. If true,
the element will not be focusable via the keyboard by tabbing. This should
be avoided except in rare scenarios where an alternative means of accessing
the element or its functionality via the keyboard is available.
props.name: excludeFromTabOrder

props.description:
The `<form>` element to associate the input with.
The value of this attribute must be the id of a `<form>` in the same document.
See [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/input#form).
props.name: form

props.description:
The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).
props.name: id

props.description:
Hints at the type of data that might be entered by the user while editing the element or its
contents. See
[MDN](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#input-modalities:-the-inputmode-attribute).
props.name: inputMode

props.description:
The maximum number of characters supported by the input. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#htmlattrdefmaxlength).
props.name: maxLength

props.description:
The minimum number of characters required by the input. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#htmlattrdefminlength).
props.name: minLength

props.description:
Regex pattern that the value of the input must match to be valid. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#htmlattrdefpattern).
props.name: pattern

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref

props.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

- You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an
  `<a>`).
- Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
- You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop
  as appropriate.
props.name: render

props.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.
props.name: slot

props.description:
An enumerated attribute that defines whether the element may be checked for spelling errors.
See [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/spellcheck).
props.name: spellCheck

props.description:
The inline [style](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/style) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the style based on component state.
props.name: style

props.description:
A function that returns an error message if a given value is invalid.
Validation errors are displayed to the user when the form is submitted
if `validationBehavior="native"`. For realtime validation, use the `isInvalid`
prop instead.
props.name: validate

props.description:
Whether to use native HTML form validation to prevent form submission
when the value is missing or invalid, or mark the field as required
or invalid via ARIA.
props.name: validationBehavior

slots.description: Root container with border, background, and flex layout. Uses `min-h-9` for flexible height and `items-center` by default, switching to `items-start` when a textarea is present.
slots.name: .input-group

slots.description: Input element with transparent background and no border. Also used as the base class for textarea elements.
slots.name: .input-group__input

slots.description: Prefix container with left border radius. Aligns to top when used with textarea.
slots.name: .input-group__prefix

slots.description: Suffix container with right border radius. Aligns to top when used with textarea.
slots.name: .input-group__suffix

slots.description: Secondary variant without shadow, suitable for use in surfaces
slots.name: .input-group--secondary
